question: In November 1950, the Fort Wayne Pistons stalled their way past George Mikan's Lakers in the lowest-scoring game in NBA history. How many field goals did both teams make combined?
question_short: Lowest-scoring NBA game ever, 1950: Pistons 19, Lakers 18. How many field goals combined?
answer_detail: Fort Wayne won 19-18, going 4 of 13 from the field while Minneapolis went 4 of 18. Stall-ball games like this led the NBA to add the 24-second shot clock in 1954.
answer_short: Each team made just 4. Games like this brought the 24-second shot clock in 1954.
